exposure: SARS-CoV-2 structural proteins (spike, nucleocapsid, membrane, envelope)
outcome: IgA antibodies in breast milk and serum
IgG antibodies in breast milk and serum
IgG1 subclass antibodies in breast milk and serum
IgG2 subclass antibodies in breast milk and serum
IgG4 subclass antibodies in breast milk and serum
finding: The study found a high seroprevalence of IgA (76.67-100%) and negativity to IgG against all analyzed proteins in breast milk, alongside varying seroprevalence for IgA (10-36.67%) and IgG (23.3-60%) in serum samples, including the detection of IgG1, IgG2, and IgG4 subclasses against all SARS-CoV-2 structural proteins.
